ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
ask.sql:
SELECT l.ARECOD                 AS location_area,
       COUNT(DISTINCT il.LODNUM) AS pallets_stored
FROM dbo.locmst l
JOIN dbo.invlod il
  ON il.WH_ID = l.WH_ID
 AND il.STOLOC = l.STOLOC
JOIN dbo.invsub s
  ON s.LODNUM = il.LODNUM
JOIN dbo.invdtl i
  ON i.SUBNUM = s.SUBNUM
WHERE l.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.ARECOD
ORDER BY l.ARECOD;

ask.question: Count open pick work per wave / pick batch
warnings: Empty in every returned row: PRICOD, BATCOD, LBLSST, RPLDTE
ask.sql:
WITH open_lines AS (
    SELECT d.INSKEY AS schbat,
           COUNT(*) AS open_pick_work_lines
    FROM dbo.wkodtl d
    WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
      AND d.INSKEY IS NOT NULL
      AND d.LINSTS <> 'C'
    GROUP BY d.INSKEY
)
SELECT b.SCHBAT AS wave_pick_batch,
       b.WH_ID,
       b.BATSTS,
       b.PRICOD,
       b.BATCOD,
       b.LBLSST,
       b.ADDDTE,
       b.RPLDTE,
       b.RELDTE,
       b.CMPDTE,
       b.NUMSLS,
       b.TOTPCS,
       b.NUMSTC,
       b.NUMPPK,
       b.NUMCPK,
       b.NUMPCK,
       b.PALVOL,
       b.ESTPAL,
       b.ESTWGT,
       b.WAVE_PRC_FLG,
       b.RULE_NAM,
       b.MODDTE,
       b.MOD_USR_ID,
       ISNULL(o.open_pick_work_lines, 0) AS open_pick_work_lines
FROM dbo.pckbat b
LEFT JOIN open_lines o
       ON o.schbat = b.SCHBAT
WHERE b.WH_ID = @wh_id
ORDER BY ISNULL(o.open_pick_work_lines, 0) DESC, b.SCHBAT;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
SELECT m.ARECOD,
       COUNT(*) AS total_locations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.CURQVL IS NULL OR m.CURQVL = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_locations
FROM dbo.locmst m
WHERE m.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY m.ARECOD
ORDER BY m.ARECOD;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
warnings: Empty in every returned row: part_description
ask.sql:
/* Inventory quantity per part and inventory status -> PrIME 2022
   Params: @wh_id
   Fix: prevent SUM(int) overflow by summing as bigint */
SELECT
    i.PRTNUM,
    i.PRT_CLIENT_ID,
    p.DSP_PRTNUM,
    d.LNGDSC AS part_description,
    i.INVSTS,
    s.LNGDSC AS invsts_description,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(i.UNTQTY, 0) AS bigint)) AS inventory_qty_units
FROM dbo.inventory_view i
LEFT JOIN dbo.prtmst p
    ON p.PRTNUM = i.PRTNUM
   AND p.PRT_CLIENT_ID = i.PRT_CLIENT_ID
   AND p.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 pd.LNGDSC
    FROM dbo.prtdsc pd
    WHERE pd.COLNAM = 'prtnum'
      AND pd.COLVAL = i.PRTNUM
      AND pd.LOCALE_ID IN ('US_ENGLISH','EN_US','ENGLISH','EN','X','X ')
      AND ISNULL(pd.IS_PURGED, 0) = 0
    ORDER BY
      CASE pd.LOCALE_ID
        WHEN 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 WHEN 'EN_US' THEN 2 WHEN 'ENGLISH' THEN 3
        WHEN 'EN' THEN 4 WHEN 'X' THEN 5 WHEN 'X ' THEN 6 ELSE 99
      END,
      pd.LNGDSC
) d
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 dm.LNGDSC
    FROM dbo.dscmst dm
    WHERE dm.COLNAM = 'invsts'
      AND dm.COLVAL = i.INVSTS
      AND dm.LOCALE_ID IN ('US_ENGLISH','EN_US','ENGLISH','EN','X','X ')
      AND ISNULL(dm.IS_PURGED, 0) = 0
    ORDER BY
      CASE dm.LOCALE_ID
        WHEN 'US_ENGLISH' THEN 1 WHEN 'EN_US' THEN 2 WHEN 'ENGLISH' THEN 3
        WHEN 'EN' THEN 4 WHEN 'X' THEN 5 WHEN 'X ' THEN 6 ELSE 99
      END,
      dm.LNGDSC
) s
WHERE i.WH_ID = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    i.PRTNUM, i.PRT_CLIENT_ID, p.DSP_PRTNUM, d.LNGDSC, i.INVSTS, s.LNGDSC
ORDER BY
    i.PRTNUM, i.PRT_CLIENT_ID, i.INVSTS;

ask.question: How many pallets (loads) are stored per location area?
warnings: Empty in every returned row: Location Area Description
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP 200
       l.ARECOD                                        AS [Location Area Code],
       ISNULL(aa.aisle_area_id, l.ARECOD)               AS [Location Area],
       ISNULL(aa.[description], CAST(NULL AS nvarchar)) AS [Location Area Description],
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.lodnum)                         AS [Pallets (Loads) Stored]
FROM dbo.locmst l
LEFT JOIN dbo.aisle_area aa
       ON aa.wh_id = l.wh_id
      AND aa.aisle_area_id = l.arecod
      AND aa.is_purged = 0
LEFT JOIN dbo.dlytrn d
       ON d.to_arecod = l.arecod
      AND d.tostol   = l.stoloc
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.ARECOD, aa.aisle_area_id, aa.[description]
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT d.lodnum) DESC, l.ARECOD;

ask.question: Top 20 parts by number of pallets in stock
warnings: Executed but returned 0 rows - check filters / parameter values before trusting it.

WITH pallets_by_part AS (
    SELECT
        d.prtnum,
        d.prt_client_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.lodnum) AS pallet_cnt
    FROM prodwms.invdtl AS d
    INNER JOIN prodwms.invlod AS l
        ON l.lodnum = d.subnum
       AND l.wh_id = @wh_id
    GROUP BY
        d.prtnum,
        d.prt_client_id
),
prt AS (
    SELECT
        p.prtnum,
        p.prt_client_id,
        p.wh_id_tmpl,
        p.dsp_prtnum
    FROM prodwms.prtmst AS p
    WHERE p.wh_id_tmpl IN (@wh_id, '----')
)
SELECT TOP (20)
    pbp.prtnum,
    pbp.prt_client_id,
    COALESCE(psite.dsp_prtnum, pdef.dsp_prtnum) AS dsp_prtnum,
    pbp.pallet_cnt
FROM pallets_by_part AS pbp
LEFT JOIN prt AS psite
    ON psite.prtnum = pbp.prtnum
   AND psite.prt_client_id = pbp.prt_client_id
   AND psite.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
LEFT JOIN prt AS pdef
    ON pdef.prtnum = pbp.prtnum
   AND pdef.prt_client_id = pbp.prt_client_id
   AND pdef.wh_id_tmpl = '----'
ORDER BY
    pbp.pallet_cnt DESC,
    pbp.prtnum,
    pbp.prt_client_id;

convert.title: CBO_P_CLASS_INVENTORY_DE07_VIEW
convert.sql:
WITH s1 AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        iv.stoloc AS LOCATN,
        iv.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        pm.prtfam AS ITMGRP,
        iv.lodnum AS ULID20,
        iv.untqty AS CASQTY,
        iv.invsts AS QASTAT,
        iv.fifdte AS FIFODT,
        iv.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        iv.ftpcod AS ULPALL,
        lm.arecod AS ZONCOD,
        CASE
            WHEN ar.bldg_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), ar.bldg_id)
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(10), 'not defined')
        END AS BLDING,
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'W' OR pm.prtfam = 'PAPPWP' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Wipes')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'R' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Rawmaterial')
            WHEN SUBSTRING(pm.prtfam, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12), 'Packmaterial')
            ELSE CONVERT(varchar(12), 'not defined')
        END AS MATTYP
    FROM dbo.inventory_view AS iv
    INNER JOIN dbo.locmst AS lm
        ON lm.wh_id = iv.wh_id
       AND lm.stoloc = iv.stoloc
    LEFT JOIN dbo.aremst AS ar
        ON ar.wh_id = lm.wh_id
       AND ar.arecod = lm.arecod
    INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst AS pm
        ON pm.prtnum = iv.prtnum
       AND pm.prt_client_id = iv.prt_client_id
       AND pm.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    WHERE iv.wh_id = @wh_id
),
s2 AS
(
    SELECT
        pfd.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        pfd.uomcod AS UOM,
        pfd.hgt AS u_height,
        pfd.pal_flg AS palflg,
        pf.ftpcod AS ULPALL
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl AS pfd
    INNER JOIN dbo.prtftp AS pf
        ON pf.wh_id = pfd.wh_id
       AND pf.prtnum = pfd.prtnum
       AND pf.prt_client_id = pfd.prt_client_id
       AND pf.ftpcod = pfd.ftpcod
    WHERE pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.stk_flg = 1
)
SELECT TOP 200
    s1.LOCATN,
    s1.ITMCOD,
    s1.ITMGRP,
    s1.ULID20,
    s1.CASQTY,
    s1.QASTAT,
    s1.FIFODT,
    s1.CTLGRP,
    s1.ULPALL,
    s1.ZONCOD,
    GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS last_update,
    s1.BLDING,
    s1.MATTYP,
    CASE
        WHEN s2.palflg = 1 THEN CONVERT(int, s2.u_height + 15)
        ELSE CONVERT(int, s2.u_height)
    END AS calculated_pal_height,
    s2.UOM,
    s1.CTLGRP AS VNDCOD,
    s1.CTLGRP AS VNDLOT,
    CONCAT(s1.ULPALL, s1.ITMCOD) AS ULPAL_ITEM
FROM s1
INNER JOIN s2
    ON s2.ITMCOD = s1.ITMCOD
   AND s2.ULPALL = s1.ULPALL;

convert.title: Direct_LINE_BEVO_PRIORITIES
convert.sql:
WITH rl AS (
    SELECT
        il.lodnum AS ULID,
        il.stoloc AS locatn,
        id.prtnum AS itmcod,
        id.lotnum AS ctlgrp,
        id.sup_lotnum AS vndlot,
        id.sup_lotnum AS vndcod
    FROM dbo.invlod il
    JOIN dbo.invsub iss
        ON iss.lodnum = il.lodnum
    JOIN dbo.invdtl id
        ON id.subnum = iss.subnum
       AND id.dtlnum = iss.subnum
    WHERE il.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND il.stoloc NOT LIKE '%RWZ%'
      AND id.invsts = 'RL'
),
B AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(ULID) AS ULIDs,
        locatn,
        itmcod,
        vndlot,
        vndcod
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY locatn, itmcod, vndlot, vndcod
),
D AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(ULID) AS ULIDs,
        vndcod,
        vndlot
    FROM rl
    GROUP BY vndcod, vndlot
),
E AS (
    SELECT
        wh.wkonum AS PRDORD,
        wh.sch_begdte AS ACTDAT,
        wh.sch_enddte AS ENDDAT,
        wd.inv_attr_str1 AS SPCCD1,
        SUM(wd.linqty - ISNULL(wd.tot_dlvqty, 0)) AS Offener_Bedarf_IN_WM_Unit,
        pl.prdlin AS LINIE,
        wd.prtnum AS ITMCOD
    FROM dbo.wkohdr wh
    JOIN dbo.wkodtl wd
        ON wd.wkonum = wh.wkonum
       AND wd.client_id = wh.client_id
       AND wd.wkorev = wh.wkorev
       AND wd.wh_id = wh.wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.prdlin_mst pl
        ON pl.prdlin = wh.prdlin
       AND pl.wh_id = wh.wh_id
    WHERE wh.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND wd.inv_attr_str2 = 'P'              -- maps source R.SPCCD1_ITMCLS = 'P' using available attribute
      AND wh.wkosts = 'A'                     -- maps source Q.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'A' using available status
      AND (wd.linqty - ISNULL(wd.tot_dlvqty, 0)) > 0
    GROUP BY
        wd.inv_attr_str1,
        wh.wkonum,
        wh.sch_begdte,
        wh.sch_enddte,
        pl.prdlin,
        wd.prtnum
)
SELECT TOP 200
    plm.prdlin AS PLNUMB,
    A.wkonum AS PRDORD,
    E.ACTDAT,
    E.ENDDAT,
    A.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
    A.inv_attr_str1 AS SPCCOD,
    A.seqnum AS LINSEQ,
    A.prcloc AS LOCATN,
    A.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
    A.sup_lotnum AS VNDCOD,
    A.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
    B.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    D.ULIDs AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Central Europe Standard Time' AS datetime), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM dbo.wkodtl A
LEFT JOIN dbo.wkohdr wh
    ON wh.wkonum = A.wkonum
   AND wh.client_id = A.client_id
   AND wh.wkorev = A.wkorev
   AND wh.wh_id = A.wh_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.prdlin_mst plm
    ON plm.prdlin = wh.prdlin
   AND plm.wh_id = wh.wh_id
LEFT JOIN B
    ON A.inv_attr_str1 = B.itmcod
   AND A.prcloc = B.locatn
   AND A.sup_lotnum = B.vndlot
   AND A.sup_lotnum = B.vndcod
LEFT JOIN D
    ON A.sup_lotnum = D.VNDCOD
   AND A.sup_lotnum = D.VNDLOT
LEFT JOIN E
    ON A.prtnum = E.ITMCOD
   AND A.inv_attr_str1 = E.SPCCD1
   AND A.wkonum = E.PRDORD
WHERE A.wh_id = @wh_id

UNION

SELECT
    NULL AS PLNUMB,
    NULL AS PRDORD,
    NULL AS ACTDAT,
    NULL AS ENDDAT,
    NULL AS ITMCOD,
    NULL AS SPCCOD,
    NULL AS LINSEQ,
    NULL AS LOCATN,
    NULL AS CTLGRP,
    NULL AS VNDCOD,
    NULL AS VNDLOT,
    NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Ort,
    NULL AS ULIDs_anhand_Vendor_Lot,
    FORMAT(MAX(dt.trndte), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS Last_Update
FROM dbo.dlytrn dt
WHERE dt.trndte IS NOT NULL;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
WITH sq1 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.dlytrn_id
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.oprcod = 'T'                 -- RTCIS sysdtl.dtltyp = 'T' (tag: CODE SET DIFFERS, using mapped column only)
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL           -- RTCIS systrn.prdord IS NOT NULL -> PrIME dlytrn.movref
      AND d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
),
p1 AS (
    SELECT TOP (200)
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(COALESCE(pd.lngdsc, pd.short_dsc), 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(id.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        id.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        u.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
     AND pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl id
      ON id.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
     AND id.subnum = d.subnum
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pdt.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pdt
        WHERE pdt.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pdt.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pdt.wh_id = @wh_id
        ORDER BY pdt.uomlvl
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pdesc.lngdsc, pdesc.short_dsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pdesc
        WHERE pdesc.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND pdesc.colval = d.prtnum
        ORDER BY pdesc.locale_id
    ) pd
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')  -- tag: CODE SET DIFFERS vs RTCIS systrn.trntyp; using provided values as-is
      AND d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
),
p2 AS (
    SELECT TOP (200)
        sq1.LOCATN,
        d.trndte AS SYSDAT,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(COALESCE(pd.lngdsc, pd.short_dsc), 15) AS ITMDSC,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(id.supnum, 4) AS VNDCOD,
        id.sup_lotnum AS VNDLOT,
        d.trnqty AS TRNQTY,
        u.uomcod AS UOM,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PRDORD,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    JOIN sq1
      ON sq1.dlytrn_id = d.dlytrn_id
    JOIN dbo.prtmst pm
      ON pm.prtnum = d.prtnum
     AND pm.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
     AND pm.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl id
      ON id.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
     AND id.subnum = d.subnum
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pdt.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pdt
        WHERE pdt.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pdt.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pdt.wh_id = @wh_id
        ORDER BY pdt.uomlvl
    ) u
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) pdesc.lngdsc, pdesc.short_dsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pdesc
        WHERE pdesc.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND pdesc.colval = d.prtnum
        ORDER BY pdesc.locale_id
    ) pd
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.oprcod = 'F'                  -- RTCIS sysdtl.dtltyp = 'F' (tag: CODE SET DIFFERS, using mapped column only)
      AND d.actcod = 'CASXFR'             -- tag: CODE SET DIFFERS vs RTCIS systrn.trntyp; using provided value as-is
      AND d.movref IS NOT NULL
      AND d.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE())
)
SELECT
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p1
UNION
SELECT
    LOCATN AS LINE,
    FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    ITMDSC AS DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VNDCOD AS VENDOR,
    VNDLOT AS VENDOR_LOT,
    TRNQTY AS QTY,
    UOM AS WM_UNIT,
    PRDORD AS PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    CONCAT(ULID, FORMAT(SYSDAT, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM p2;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_DELIVERY_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CASE d.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE d.tostol END AS LINE,
        FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        d.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        LEFT(COALESCE(pd.lngdsc, pd.short_dsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
        d.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
        LEFT(i.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
        i.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
        d.trnqty AS QTY,
        uom1.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
        SUBSTRING(d.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        LEFT(d.lodnum, 20) AS ULID,
        CONCAT(LEFT(d.lodnum, 20), FORMAT(d.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
    FROM dbo.dlytrn d
    LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl i
        ON i.dtlnum = d.dtlnum
       AND i.subnum = d.subnum
    INNER JOIN dbo.prtmst p
        ON p.prtnum = d.prtnum
       AND p.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
       AND p.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pd1.lngdsc, pd1.short_dsc
        FROM dbo.prtdsc pd1
        WHERE pd1.colnam = 'prtnum'
          AND pd1.colval = d.prtnum
          AND pd1.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pd1.locale_id
    ) pd
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 pfd.uomcod
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = d.prtnum
          AND pfd.prt_client_id = d.prt_client_id
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
    ) uom1
    WHERE d.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND d.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND d.trndte >= DATEADD(minute, -120, GETDATE())
      AND d.trndte <= GETDATE()
      AND (
            d.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')  -- [OBS7] kept as-is; may need actcod value mapping vs RTCIS TRNTYP
         OR (d.oprcod = 'F' AND d.actcod = 'CASXFR' AND d.movref IS NOT NULL) -- [OBS7] dtltyp/trntyp mapping assumed
          )
)
SELECT TOP 200
    LINE,
    DELIVERY_DATE,
    ITMCOD,
    DESCRIPTION,
    CTLGRP,
    VENDOR,
    VENDOR_LOT,
    QTY,
    WM_UNIT,
    PROCESS_ORDER,
    ULID,
    ID_NR
FROM base;

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_DAS
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       CASE dlytrn.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE dlytrn.tostol END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(dlytrn.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       dlytrn.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(COALESCE(prtdsc_apply.lngdsc, prtdsc_apply.short_dsc), 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       dlytrn.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(invdtl.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       invdtl.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       dlytrn.trnqty AS QTY,
       prtftp_dtl_apply.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(dlytrn.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       dlytrn.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(dlytrn.lodnum, FORMAT(dlytrn.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn
JOIN dbo.prtmst
  ON prtmst.prtnum = dlytrn.prtnum
 AND prtmst.prt_client_id = dlytrn.prt_client_id
 AND prtmst.wh_id_tmpl = @wh_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl
  ON invdtl.dtlnum = dlytrn.dtlnum
 AND invdtl.subnum = dlytrn.subnum
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           prtftp_dtl.uomcod
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl
    WHERE prtftp_dtl.prtnum = dlytrn.prtnum
      AND prtftp_dtl.prt_client_id = dlytrn.prt_client_id
      AND prtftp_dtl.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND prtftp_dtl.stk_flg = 1
    ORDER BY prtftp_dtl.uomlvl
) AS prtftp_dtl_apply
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           prtdsc.lngdsc,
           prtdsc.short_dsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc
    WHERE prtdsc.colnam = 'prtnum'
      AND prtdsc.colval = dlytrn.prtnum
      AND prtdsc.is_purged = 0
) AS prtdsc_apply
WHERE dlytrn.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND prtmst.typcod = 'P'
  AND dlytrn.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND dlytrn.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND dlytrn.trndte > DATEADD(day, -3, GETDATE());

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURN_HISTORY_FROM_RTCIS
convert.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
       CASE dlytrn.tostol WHEN 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4' WHEN 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3' ELSE dlytrn.tostol END AS LINE,
       FORMAT(dlytrn.trndte, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS RETURN_DATE,
       dlytrn.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
       LEFT(prtdsc_x.lngdsc, 15) AS DESCRIPTION,
       dlytrn.lotnum AS CTLGRP,
       LEFT(invdtl.supnum, 4) AS VENDOR,
       invdtl.sup_lotnum AS VENDOR_LOT,
       dlytrn.trnqty AS QTY,
       prtftp_dtl_x.uomcod AS WM_UNIT,
       SUBSTRING(dlytrn.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
       dlytrn.lodnum AS ULID,
       CONCAT(dlytrn.lodnum, FORMAT(dlytrn.trndte, 'yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss')) AS ID_NR
FROM dbo.dlytrn
JOIN dbo.prtmst
  ON prtmst.prtnum = dlytrn.prtnum
 AND prtmst.prt_client_id = dlytrn.prt_client_id
 AND prtmst.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.invdtl
  ON invdtl.dtlnum = dlytrn.dtlnum
 AND invdtl.subnum = dlytrn.subnum
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           prtdsc.lngdsc
    FROM dbo.prtdsc
    WHERE prtdsc.colnam = 'prtmst.prtnum'
      AND prtdsc.colval = dlytrn.prtnum
      AND prtdsc.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY prtdsc.locale_id
) prtdsc_x
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
           pfd.uomcod
    FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
    WHERE pfd.prtnum = dlytrn.prtnum
      AND pfd.prt_client_id = dlytrn.prt_client_id
      AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND pfd.is_purged = 0
    ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl
) prtftp_dtl_x
WHERE dlytrn.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND prtmst.typcod = 'P'
  AND dlytrn.tostol LIKE 'ULIN%'
  AND dlytrn.actcod = 'MANLID'
  AND dlytrn.trndte > DATEADD(day, -33, GETDATE())
  AND dlytrn.trndte <= GETDATE();

convert.title: IMP_LINE_RETURNS_90days_wholeQtyBack
convert.sql:
WITH deliv AS (
    SELECT
        st.trndte AS DELIVERY_DATE,
        CASE
            WHEN sd.frstol = 'SILOB' THEN 'ULINA4'
            WHEN sd.frstol = 'SILOA' THEN 'ULINA3'
            ELSE sd.frstol
        END AS LINE,
        SUBSTRING(st.movref, 4, 9) AS PROCESS_ORDER,
        sd.prtnum AS ITMCOD,
        st.trnqty AS QTY,
        iu.WHSE_UNIT,
        LEFT(sd.lodnum, 20) AS ULID
    FROM dbo.dlytrn sd
    JOIN dbo.dlytrn st
      ON st.dlytrn_id = sd.dlytrn_id
     AND st.wh_id = @wh_id
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pfd.uomcod AS WHSE_UNIT
        FROM dbo.prtftp_dtl pfd
        WHERE pfd.prtnum = sd.prtnum
          AND pfd.wh_id = @wh_id
          AND pfd.rcv_flg = 1
          AND pfd.is_purged = 0
        ORDER BY pfd.uomlvl ASC, pfd.uomcod ASC
    ) iu
    WHERE sd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND sd.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND st.actcod IN ('DEPSUL', 'LINUSE')
),
ret AS (
    SELECT
        sd.lodnum AS ULID,
        st.trndte AS RETURN_DATE,
        st.trnqty AS QTY
    FROM dbo.dlytrn sd
    JOIN dbo.dlytrn st
      ON st.dlytrn_id = sd.dlytrn_id
     AND st.wh_id = @wh_id
    WHERE sd.wh_id = @wh_id
      AND sd.frstol LIKE 'ULIN%'
      AND st.actcod = 'MANLID'
),
RankedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT
        a.DELIVERY_DATE,
        a.LINE,
        a.PROCESS_ORDER,
        a.ITMCOD,
        c.prtfam AS ITMGRP,
        g.lngdsc AS grpdsc,
        a.QTY,
        a.WHSE_UNIT,
        a.ULID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ULID ORDER BY a.DELIVERY_DATE ASC) AS DeliveryRank
    FROM deliv a
    JOIN dbo.prtmst c
      ON c.prtnum = a.ITMCOD
     AND c.WH_ID_TMPL = @wh_id
    LEFT JOIN dbo.dscmst g
      ON g.colnam = 'prtfam'
     AND g.colval = c.prtfam
     AND g.is_purged = 0
    WHERE a.DELIVERY_DATE > CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -90, GETDATE()) AS date)
      AND a.DELIVERY_DATE < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE 'ULINA%'
      AND a.LINE NOT LIKE 'ULINC%'
),
RankedReturns AS (
    SELECT
        b.ULID,
        b.RETURN_DATE,
        b.QTY,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.ULID ORDER BY b.RETURN_DATE ASC) AS ReturnRank
    FROM ret b
)
SELECT TOP (200)
    d.DELIVERY_DATE,
    d.LINE,
    d.PROCESS_ORDER,
    d.ITMCOD,
    d.ITMGRP,
    d.grpdsc,
    d.QTY,
    d.WHSE_UNIT,
    d.ULID,
    r.RETURN_DATE,
    r.QTY AS RETURN_QTY,
    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) AS DATE_DIFF
FROM RankedDeliveries d
JOIN RankedReturns r
  ON d.ULID = r.ULID
 AND d.DeliveryRank = r.ReturnRank
WHERE d.DELIVERY_DATE < r.RETURN_DATE
  AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, d.DELIVERY_DATE, r.RETURN_DATE) < 960
  AND d.QTY = r.QTY
ORDER BY d.ULID, d.DELIVERY_DATE ASC;
